d:
Experience the power of mesmerizing music with Aditya Music and their latest release, "Saami Saami Video Song". This catchy Telugu Song from the Film "Pushpa" stars Allu Arjun and Rashmika Mandanna in passionate roles. Music director Devi Sri Prasad has once again worked his magic with this foot-tapping track.
Discover this Song on Popular Streaming Platforms.
Song Credits:
Song Name: Saami Saami
Singer: Mounika Yadav
Lyricist: Chandrabose
Music: Devi Sri Prasad
Keyboards: Vikas Badisa
